newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Vanke mulls rights offer plan.
newsitem.headline: China Vanke mulls rights offer plan.

text.p: Shenzhen-based China Vanke Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to make a 2.727-for-10 rights offer and use the proceeds to develop real estate projects and increase its land reserve in Shenzhen.

The offer, tentatively priced at between 4.5 and five yuan per rights share, will be presented to a shareholders' meeting scheduled for February 19, Vanke said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The rights plan requires the final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, it added.
On Monday, Vanke's A shares closed at 10.41 yuan each, with its B shares at HK$5.54.

Earlier, Vanke's chairman Wang Shi told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that the firm plans to step up its property investment in Shenzhen due to rising confidence in the city's real estate market.

Wang said Vanke had been preparing for a turnaround in Shenzhen's real estate market since the end of 1995, when it increased its land reserve in the city by 45,000 square metres for future development. Vanke, which has property projects in a number of China's major cities, plans to focus its investment on Shenzhen over the next few years, Wang said.
